name: What are the advantages of using a wax-free toilet seal instead of a traditional wax ring?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of using a wax-free toilet seal instead of a traditional wax ring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wax-free toilet seals offer several advantages over traditional wax rings, primarily in their reusability and tolerance for minor toilet adjustments. Unlike wax rings, which are compressed and deformed upon installation and must be replaced if the toilet is moved, wax-free seals can often be reused if the toilet needs to be reset. They are also less messy and can accommodate variations in flange height more flexibly. However, traditional wax rings are often praised for their proven sealing capability over decades. CG Plumbing Solutions can discuss both options and recommend the best solution based on your toilet's specific installation requirements and your preferences for maintenance flexibility. This is a comparison, explaining the Practical Tradeoffs between two reasonable options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wax-free seals are reusable and less messy, allowing minor adjustments. Traditional wax rings are proven for sealing. Choose based on installation needs and preferences.
